title: Dwarf
description: Become a true Dwarf the moment you enter the world.
body:
# Dwarf

Become a true Dwarf the moment you enter the world.

No commands. No setup. No race selection. Simply install the mod and every player automatically becomes a Dwarf.

Designed for Hardcore worlds, SMPs, and survival-focused playthroughs, Dwarf changes your size and physical traits while keeping the core Minecraft experience intact.

## Features

### Size

- - ![You and Pig are the same size now!!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d061d93c70d5e7c503ba3c6748f477a11e6b6f5e_0.webp)
- ![Hide in one block block Gap !](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/13b86c20df52cca1661975018aa2abd25c51206b.png)
- Matching 1 block hitbox
- Lower camera height
- Smaller player model visible to everyone
- Move through 1-block-high spaces without crawling

### Strengths

- 25% knockback resistance
- 20% reduced fall damage

### Weaknesses

- 10% slower movement speed
- 10% reduced attack reach

### Vanilla Friendly

This mod does **not** add:

- Abilities
- Skills
- Mana systems
- Cooldowns
- Classes
- RPG mechanics
- Commands

The following mechanics remain unchanged:

- Jump height
- Health
- Hunger
- Armor
- Attack damage
- Swimming
- Vanilla progression

## Multiplayer Support

Dwarf works in both singleplayer and multiplayer worlds. Player scaling is synchronized so everyone sees the correct dwarf size.

## Dependencies

This mod requires:

- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Pehkui](https://modrinth.com/mod/pehkui)
## Why Dwarf?

Most race mods add complicated systems, abilities, classes, and progression mechanics.

Dwarf focuses on a single idea:

**What if every player was a 1-block-tall Dwarf?**

Simple. Lightweight. Survival-friendly.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft Fabric 1.21+
- Singleplayer
- Multiplayer
- Dedicated Servers

**1 Block Tall. Built To Survive.**
